# rind on `jetson-orin-nano`: aarch64

3 runs of rind's own `admin/bench-report run` at [`98568332`](https://github.com/moq-dev/rind/commit/985683329fb98aebfaae6c493f205f20070a8fca), each pinned to one core. Every time is the median of the runs' criterion estimates (`jetson-orin-nano.json`, schema 1, with each run's estimate in `runs_ns`); [RUNS.md](RUNS.md) lists every run, [facts.txt](facts.txt) the hardware and load, and [NOTES.md](NOTES.md) how the host was run and what to read into the numbers.

- CPU: aarch64 (aarch64, 6 logical CPUs)
- OS: Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS (Linux 6.8.12-1021-tegra)
- Toolchain: rustc 1.98.1 (48a229cea 2026-09-01)
- OpenSSL linked: OpenSSL 3.0.13 30 Jan 2024 (Library: OpenSSL 3.0.13 30 Jan 2024)
- CPU features rind reads (rind-cpuid): aes, neon, pmull, sha2; absent: dit, sha3
- Libraries refused for missing CPU features: none
- Noisy (bench-report's flag, any run): no
